description: Experiment 15B (plan experiment D): query-api ECS scale-out and scale-in under CPU target tracking, driven by load-tests/loadgen.py at concurrency 1, 5, 25 and 50, then a sustained hold at 50 and a no-load observation window. Non-LLM endpoints by default; a small fixed sample of synthesized answers (POST /v1/query) only when the operator passes --llm, inside the 15b answer bucket of the shared claude-haiku-5-5 (Anthropic API) cap of USD 1.33.

scaling_policy.type: ECS service target tracking on ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization (standard AWS/ECS metric; Container Insights is off)
scaling_policy.target_percent_reference: cpu_target_percent in infra/terraform/phase12b-variables.tf (default 60); read the applied value before the run, it is not in this file
scaling_policy.scale_in_alarm: AWS-managed low alarm needs 15 consecutive one-minute datapoints under 90 percent of the target, so scale-in cannot start before about 15 minutes of low CPU
scaling_policy.capacity_source: service_capacity.query-api in the private tfvars (the example file has min 1, max 2); confirm with aws application-autoscaling describe-scalable-targets before the run
scaling_policy.fargate_shape: 0.25 vCPU / 1 GiB, raised only in private tfvars

phases.name: baseline-1
phases.purpose: baseline CPU, latency and task count at concurrency 1

phases.name: hold-50
phases.purpose: sustain concurrency 50 for 10 minutes so CPU stays above target for the three one-minute datapoints a scale-out needs and the new task has time to start (health-check grace 300 s); no LLM calls

phases.name: cooldown-observe
phases.purpose: no load for 30 minutes: scale-in needs 15 low minutes plus the 300 s cooldown; evidence is the metric rows before, during and after, collected outside this process

llm.note: Opt-in only with --llm --remaining-cap-usd X --questions-file F and an existing ledger. Answer budget per level 10/15/20/15 = 60 answers (USD 0.0819 at the pinned estimate of USD 0.001365 per answer: 10 / 15 / 20 / 15 answers = USD 0.01365 / 0.020475 / 0.0273 / 0.020475), charged to the 15b bucket, which is a hard stop; the hold phase sends none. Buckets (at the time of this plan 14c 10 / 15b 60 / 16b 40 / 17 5; 16b 80 and 17 10 since the user decision of 2026-11-21): experiments/manifests/llm-allocation.json. Cost reporting for the run: AWS, Anthropic and Voyage as separate items, then the combined total (the run record has cost_report).

metrics_to_collect.note: the task count over time as a standard metric: 1 to 2 is the scale-out, 2 back to 1 the scale-in
Container Insights is off, so AWS/ECS RunningTaskCount does not exist; poll the service every minute with UTC timestamps
start and end time and cause of each scale-out and scale-in

metrics_to_collect.metric: target tracking alarm state changes for query-api
per-request latency, status and route with run IDs
metrics_to_collect.note: target/experiment-runs/15b-ecs-scaling-<run-id>/raw/ (sha256 sealed); derived/timeline.csv has one row per UTC minute

provenance.requirements: docs/agent-runs/phase-14/prompt.md (Replan decisions; Answers item 4; Gap routing item 5), plan phase15.md experiment D

limits_note: Known limitation to report: query-api max is 2 tasks, so scale-out is 1 to 2 only. If CPU never exceeds the target at concurrency 50 on non-LLM routes, no scale-out happens; report that and the CPU values rather than tuning the service or the target inside the run.
